description.value: Co-op Parallel Food Store is a full-service supermarket operated by Otter Co-op, a Federated Co-operatives member that took over this location from Save-On-Foods in July 2020. The store operates under the alt name 'Otter Co-op Parallel Food and Pharmacy,' indicating an in-store pharmacy alongside groceries and a liquor department. As a consumer co-operative, shoppers can join as members to access exclusive savings programs.
